description: The variable substitution is a left and right identity for composition of simultaneous substitutions.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose_id.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {β : Type w'} (σ : α → L.Term β) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose FirstOrder.Language.var σ = σ ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose σ FirstOrder.Language.var = σ
